title: Decoder floors: every label window h ≥ 12 is closed in the root-code scope (clique bound + DRAT-verified h = 12–14; no κ claim)
body:
Follows #2639 (windows `h = 10, 11`; parent #2338). Research note and verifier; **no κ claim**, no window, no supplier, no word-side cost. Package: `research/label-windows-h12-plus/`.

## Result

In the root-code scope of #2639 §3, for any number of terms `m ≥ 8` and any fitting `B` of `F2`-rank `≤ h`, **every label window `h ≥ 12` is closed** (no decoder pays), under the pricing model inherited from #2639 / #2338. Labels: PROVEN / CHECKED / RECORDED / CONDITIONAL as in the README.

* **Lemma C (PROVEN).** `rank B[R,A] ≥ ω(R ∩ A)`, the clique number of the non-orthogonality graph on `R ∩ A`: a clique gives an identity submatrix of any fitting `B` (any `h`, any gauge, any factorisation).
* **Census (CHECKED).** `min ω = 5` over all `47 × 440,880 = 20,721,360` section pairs, by two independently written exact C++ programs (+ networkx on the exceptional pairs, pynauty for the orbits): 3 pairs with `ω = 5`, 141 with `ω = 6`, all others `≥ 7`; 6 exceptional orbits under `Aut` (order 172,032) and transposition. Hence every term has rank `≥ 5`, cost `≥ 40`, which exceeds the break-even for every `h ≥ 15` (`X(112,40,h)/base` is strictly decreasing for `h = 15..200`, computed, not extrapolated).
* **`h = 12, 13, 14` (CHECKED, DRAT VERIFIED).** 61 orbit queries UNSAT (kissat 4.0.4, drat-trim): terms `≥ 7 / 6 / 6`, cost `≥ 56 > 51`, `48 > 46`, `48 > 42`.
* **The 696 `T(12, l+k = 7)` queries** that #2639 lists as not run: 696/696 UNSAT, DRAT VERIFIED (a side result, implied by the above).
* **Break-even `h = 11..18`: 55 / 51 / 46 / 42 / 38 / 33 / 29 / 25 is RECORDED** from the inherited pricing model (reproduced by `verify.sh`, not derived or audited here); the closures are CONDITIONAL on it.
* **Scope.** #1212 Theorem 1 (merged) makes every rank-8 realisation of the P112 pattern a diagonal rescaling of the Gram matrix with the Gram zero pattern, so the root-code scope covers non-Gram rank-8 realisations. It concerns the matrix `M`; decoders whose factors lie outside `col M` stay outside the claim.

## Evidence and reproduction

The SAT encoder `sat/hk3.py` is shared with #2639 (two marked path/IO edits). CNFs are regenerated deterministically; their sha256 are recorded with the kissat times and drat-trim verdicts in `evidence/drat_61.log` and `evidence/drat_696.log` (DRAT files are not shipped: the largest is about 1.6 GB). `bash research/label-windows-h12-plus/verify.sh /fresh/dir` runs the lemma check on all exceptional pairs, the full `cen.cpp` census and a partial `mc.cpp` census, the orbit checks, the break-even / `X(40,h)` computation, the log accounting, and 14 SAT queries (CNF hash + kissat + drat-trim); `FULL=1` runs everything (all pairs, all 757 queries, about two hours, at most two processes).
